rule: docs/adr/0001-gift-cards-remain-bearer-instruments.md (Enforcement must not leak who a card belongs to)
naive: Look the card up by code (active, unexpired) and return its current_balance without checking usage_restriction_reason / assignment, so a card restricted to another customer (or to a deleted customer) gets a different answer than an unknown code and acts as an oracle for guessed codes and ownership.
